page.overview:
Who is Captain Majesty?

Captain Majesty is a contestant in the 59th Card Wars Doubles Classic who appears in the episode "Daddy-Daughter Card Wars". He is seen with his partner near a wall as Jake and Charlie walk pass them.

Captain Majesty is a long, green lizard who wears a brown hat and a bandanna tied around his neck. He bears a strong resemblance to the stereotypical cowboy.
